note: Superseded digests of the four source files run_combined.py hashes into every shard's manifest. A shard bought on an older version of the pass is still auditable ONLY if somebody wrote down why that version's rows mean the same thing; re-stamping the manifest instead would erase the provenance of a paid run to make a checker quiet. So the check stays strict and the exceptions are here, each naming the commit that superseded it and what that commit did. An unlisted digest is a refusal. Add an entry only after reading the diff: `git diff <commit>^ <commit> -- scripts/v2/<file>`.

run_combined.py.why: #60 added the delta pass's `state_section_ids` branch to `classify`, a refusal for a state carrying no article section, and a `sectionDecisions` figure in the PLAN summary. The `state_section_ids=None` path the corpus pass runs is unchanged, and none of it reaches a row, so combined-v1-r2's rows are what this file would still produce. #50 also retitled one docstring line.

typesafe_client.py.why: #63 widened the retry to connection failures that arrive without an HTTP status and made the client obey a Retry-After. It touches when a request is repeated, not what is sent or how the answer is parsed, so a row bought through the old transport is the same row.
